name: hud_ui_zrd_widget_hide_preview
description: HudUiZrdWidget::HidePreview restores the default image, clears rollover playback state, and returns label visibility to the normal state.
known_limits: tier S verification remains deferred to the HudUiZrdWidget source-cluster pass.
